latest.title: Kilter: AX-1 weeding avoids 1M liters herbicide. What to know before investing.
latest.originalTitle: Kilter: AX-1 weeding avoids 1M liters herbicide. What to know before investing.
latest.summary: 農業機械の新製品・技術・現場動向を紹介する海外記事です。
latest.originalSummary: Kilter’s AX-1 robots apply herbicide in precise micro-droplets directly onto weeds, and have helped growers avoid spraying more than 1 million litres of herbicide mixture compared to what conventional broadcast spraying would have used. Future Farming asks the Norwegian company how this number was calculated, which growers benefit most from the AX-1, and what buyers should consider before investing.
